evidence: Heavily modifies src/wallet/spend.cpp, src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp, src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, and wallet persistence.
rationale: Enables the wallet to send to BIP 352 silent payment addresses across send, sendtoaddress, sendmany, and sendall. It dynamically derives Taproot output scripts via ECDH on input keys and persists metadata to support RBF fee bumps, introducing substantial user-facing privacy value.
